verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party Questionnaire Automation page says it combs through your knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses for new questionnaires. Its agentic workflow leaves the user to review, approve, and submit, and the AI Agent page and new Customer Trust questionnaire-response API endpoints reinforce this. That matches the story's AI-drafted, human-reviewed workflow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers are grounded in live controls/test status (not just docs and past questionnaires); independent or hands-on corroboration of draft accuracy.
